dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: You keep treating every disagreement like a puzzle. What do you actually think?

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: I'm curious too. Just your view, not a theory.

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.text: I thought Owen meant the train station.

dialogue.speaker: Owen
dialogue.text: No, I meant the ferry landing. Sorry I wasn't clear.

dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: I'm still figuring out what I want to say.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: Take your time. We don't need to fill every silence.

dialogue.speaker: Allen
dialogue.text: Did we ever decide where the bridge in that photo was?

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: No. We guessed it was near the coast but never verified it.

dialogue.speaker: Sarah
dialogue.text: I think we've exhausted the bus timetable question.

dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: I'd rather talk about something we're genuinely interested in.

dialogue.speaker: Jules
dialogue.text: We keep talking in circles about talking in circles.

dialogue.speaker: Mara
dialogue.text: It's getting very old, talking in circles about talking in circles.
